headline: Argentine Economy Minister Rejects Pressure to Inject Pesos, Blames Bank Lending Caution on Uncertainty
summary: Economy Minister Luis Caputo defended monetary policy before the UIA, stating that banks are withholding credit due to economic uncertainty and rejecting calls to issue more pesos.
why: The Argentine Industrial Union represents domestic manufacturing leaders, and credit availability remains central to industrial capital expenditure in the country.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Restricting money supply growth and credit policies directly affects domestic liquidity and borrowing costs.
